templates.title: Atrium
templates.name: atrium
templates.description: Client portal for agencies and freelancers. Share project progress, files, tasks and invoices through a branded portal. Includes a built-in PostgreSQL database.
templates.note: Needs an auth secret of at least 32 characters — generate one with openssl rand -base64 32. Over plain HTTP set SECURE_COOKIES to false, or sign-in fails with a CSRF error.

env.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
env.label: Auth secret
env.description: Random string, minimum 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

env.name: WEB_URL
env.label: Public URL
env.description: The address people open in a browser, e.g. https://portal.example.com. Leave blank only for local testing — email invitation and password-reset links are built from this.

env.name: API_URL
env.label: Public API URL
env.description: Same value as the public URL — the unified image serves the app and API from one origin.

env.name: SECURE_COOKIES
env.label: Secure cookies
env.description: Set to false when accessing over plain HTTP. Leave as true behind an HTTPS reverse proxy.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: External database URL (optional)
env.description: Leave blank to use the built-in PostgreSQL. Example: postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/atrium
